author: Michael Larabel
description: Nate Graham and John Veness are out today with the newest issue of This Week in Plasma. Notable for KDE Plasma 6.6.x~6.7 development this week were a lot of bug fixing -- including multiple crash fixes -- and some UI polishing too...
title: KDE Plasma Saw A Lot Of Bug/Crash Fixing & UI Polishing This Week

author: Michael Larabel
description: Wine 11.4 is out today as the latest bi-weekly development release of this open-source software that powers Valve's Steam Play (Proton) and allows for Windows games and applications to run on Linux and macOS...
title: Wine 11.4 Released With More Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: Ahead of the GNOME 50 desktop release coming up in less than two weeks, GTK 4.22 is out today as the newest stable version of the GTK4 toolkit...
title: GTK 4.22 Released With Improved SVG Support, Reduced Motion Option

author: Michael Larabel
description: A pull request sent out today and already merged to Linux Git ahead of Sunday's Linux 7.0-rc3 has some new hardware driver support additions for the likes of ASUS, HP, Dell, and OneXPlayer...
title: New ASUS, Dell & OneXPlayer Hardware Support In Linux 7.0-rc3

author: Michael Larabel
description: For those looking for a low-power, well-built small office / home office Linux server with interesting connectivity options, the ZimaBoard 2 is an interesting option that has been available for some months now and powered by the Intel N150 processor. Besides the interesting single board hardware and well built aluminum chassis, the offering is rounded out by being preloaded with ZimaOS as a Linux-based "personal cloud OS" to easily get hosting for your own SOHO server needs.
title: ZimaBoard 2: An Interesting Intel-Powered Linux Home Mini Server

author: Michael Larabel
description: Sent out today was this week's batch of Slab allocator fixes for the Linux 7.0 development kernel. Making this pull notable is fixing a "severe performance regression" with a ~64% performance drop having been noted in late February...
title: Linux 7.0 Slab Fix On The Way For A "Severe Performance Regression"

author: Michael Larabel
description: Patches were posted today to the Linux kernel mailing list for enabling a new feature called AMD CPPC Performance Priority as a new hardware feature being found with "future AMD processors".... Which given the timing of these patches, almost certainly means the upcoming Zen 6 processors...
title: AMD CPPC Performance Priority Being Prepared For Linux - New Zen 6 Feature

author: Michael Larabel
description: Canonical engineer Serkan Uygungelen published a post outlining some of the Intel Xeon CPU features to be supported by the upcoming Ubuntu 26.04 LTS release, some Xeon features already supported by the existing Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and some features only partially supported for still not having packaged user-space libraries/support within the Ubuntu archive...
title: Intel Xeon Features To Be Supported By Ubuntu 26.04 LTS - Some Lacking User-Space Packages

author: Michael Larabel
description: Four years ago Oracle announced Solaris CBE as the "Common Build Environment" version of Solaris 11.4. Oracle Solaris CBE is made available as free for open-source developers and other non-production use. Oracle this week released a new version of Solaris CBE for those wanting this free* version of Solaris...
title: Oracle Updates Free Solaris CBE For Open-Source Developers / Non-Production Uses

author: Michael Larabel
description: The big NetBSD 11.0 release continues on approach with NetBSD 11.0-RC2 having been released as the latest test candidate...
title: NetBSD 11.0-RC2 Released For Testing

author: Michael Larabel
description: The BeOS-inspired Haiku open-source operating system project had an eventful February with a number of driver improvements and a variety of other enhancements...
title: Haiku OS Pulls In WiFi Driver Updates From OpenBSD, Other Improvements In February

author: Michael Larabel
description: Vulkan 1.4.345 released overnight as the latest routine spec update to this graphics and compute API. There is one new extension besides a handful of different clarifications and corrections to various elements of the spec...
title: Vulkan 1.4.345 Released With New ARM Shader Instrumentation Extension
